say:1:1035826001:1.text: Please don't worry. The Templar Order will escort the acolytes back to safety.
say:1:1035826001:1.source_cn: 请不用担心这一点。圣骑士团会护送修士返回。
say:1:1035826001:1.male: Please don't worry. The Templar Order will escort the acolytes back to safety.
say:1:1035826001:1.female: Please don't worry. The Templar Order will escort the acolytes back to safety.

say:2:1035826002:1.text: No matter where or when or what evils lurk about, Dura will always protect us.
say:2:1035826002:1.source_cn: 无论何时何地，发生怎样的灾难，女神都会庇佑我们。
say:2:1035826002:1.male: No matter where or when or what evils lurk about, Dura will always protect us.
say:2:1035826002:1.female: No matter where or when or what evils lurk about, Dura will always protect us.
